title: Kent Paul and the 1986 Malibu Club trip ('Life Is Passing Me By')
location_description: Starts at Donnie's Radio Tower in Key Lento (breaker switch and button turn on a 1986 Malibu Club ad on an old TV). Then 12 LPL substations around Leonida, whose graffiti spells LIFE IS PASSING ME BY; press the W, A, D and dot stickers in the order D, D, dot, A, dot, A, A, A, dot, W, D, W. An SMS reads 'U-235 REACTOR2 19-06': go to Reactor 2 at the T.H. Power Station east of Hamlet between 19:00 and 06:00. No fast travel or taxis during the chain, or it resets.
evidence: Forum post gives the full chain: the substation letters spell Vice City's speed-up-time cheat, the button order follows that PS2 cheat, and the reactor triggers a playable PS2-style Malibu Club scene with retro Jason and Kent Paul and the old square radar; afterwards Kent Paul phones the player. Memeio's video (9.3M views) shows it independently a day later. Replies confirm the first tower and lever are in Key Lento and that a call follows.
verification_suggestion: multi-source. first_finder: pedro alduare (GTAForums, earliest public post found, 2026-11-22 21:09 UTC; url null unless a profile link is confirmed). Memeio claims he found it first but posted later and one reply says it was taken from the forum: note the dispute in notes. Link related_connections kent-paul-maccer. Replies say Kent Paul is voiced by his original actor: unconfirmed, leave out or write 'fans say'. The forum's substation map is an image hosted off-site: do not copy. GTAForums posts are typed 'article' (the schema has no forum type).

title: Free pink Growler behind a keypad garage (code 92665)
location_description: Chapter 3. In the apartment bedroom, flip the dog drawing on the vanity for '15'; the dog photo by the flamingo wall says 'Muffins'. Laptop password: Muffins, Queen, 15. An unknown message gives the code 92665. The garage keypad is by the pink bow wall in southern La Perle, next to Auntie's Place (another post says across from the 'Twa Ponya' tattoo shop).
evidence: Viral post (5.4M views) gives the code and says it works with Lucia or Jason; replies stress the laptop must be unlocked first. GTA6_Stars posts the full step list with a video: the reward is a pink Growler you can register at Pay 'n' Spray or sell for $14,750. A reply mentions a second car in a nearby Scoop storage unit.
verification_suggestion: single-source until a reviewer confirms the GTA6_Stars video shows it in their own game, then multi-source. 'La Perle' is not in content/regions.json: add it only with a source. chapter_gate: Chapter 3. Do not include the money and wall-clip glitches posted in the same thread.

title: Bug compilation from launch day
evidence: Viral compilation (5.1M views) of bugs seen in the first hours: players stuck in a cage, a plane hitting a building without exploding, NPCs walking into walls. Rockstar's 23 Nov update fixed weather not changing, autosave, phone calls not triggering, being unable to lose a wanted level, the gym deadlift bar and partners not handing over bags.
verification_suggestion: Better as sources on the existing boat-stuck-on-bridge-glitch entry or a launch-bugs explainer than a new find. The compilation re-uploads other people's clips without credit: do not use it as the clip. Use the Rockstar page to mark fixed bugs as patched.
